breakdown.description: The prompt collapses the distributed self-weight into a single end load and calls it exact, even though the axial force from self-weight varies continuously along the bar.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses the distributed self-weight approach with the continuously varying axial force P(x) = ρ * g * A * (L - x) and integrates it over the bar length. It does not mention or use the incorrect simplification of replacing the distributed load with a single concentrated end load. This matches the ground truth prompt's approach.
